T1.title: Crate scaffold, config, project
T1.what: Create `memo-cli` (workspace member) with clap skeleton for all subcommands (`login logout status doctor config recall remember note hook mcp statusline events install uninstall flush`), unimplemented ones exiting 2 with "not implemented". Implement `config.rs` (layering, `memo config show` with `client_id` shown, tokens never), `project.rs` (project name, branch, sanitiser, `default`).

requirements.text: Config SHALL resolve in order: env (`MEMO_URL`, `MEMO_*`) > project `.memo.toml` (nearest ancestor of cwd) > `~/.config/memo/config.toml` > defaults; `memo config show` SHALL print the effective config with secrets redacted.

doneWhen.text: Unit: layering order env > project > user > default for every key group; nearest-ancestor `.memo.toml`; project name in git repo / subdir / non-git / unsanitisable → `default`; branch from `.git/HEAD` (ref and detached)
`memo --help` lists all subcommands; Quick gate passes; clippy clean

T2.title: Local state
T2.what: `state.rs` per Shared contracts: state dir (0700), session files, events log with rotation, health cache, write queue (enqueue with bounds 100 entries / 5 MiB dropping oldest and counting drops in `S/queue/.drops`, list oldest-first, remove, flock), atomic writes.

requirements.text: WHEN a remember fails THEN its payload SHALL be appended to the local write queue; every later hook SHALL first try to flush the queue (bounded to 1 s), oldest first; queue bound 100 entries / 5 MiB, dropping oldest and counting drops.

doneWhen.text: Unit: session round trip; counters increment; events append + rotation at 1 MiB; queue bounds by count and bytes with drop counter; oldest-first order
Integration: 8 threads/processes appending events and incrementing the same session concurrently lose no updates (use a per-session lock file)
Quick + `cargo test -p memo-cli` pass

T3.title: Login, credentials, token
T3.what: `auth/` per DD-02/DD-08. `memo login [url]` (stores url into user config when given): fetch `<url>/.well-known/oauth-protected-resource/mcp` → `resource`, `authorization_servers[0]`; OIDC discovery `<issuer>/.well-known/openid-configuration` (fallback RFC 8414 `/.well-known/oauth-authorization-server`); client id from config else DCR (`registration_endpoint`, `token_endpoint_auth_method: none`, `redirect_uris: ["http://127.0.0.1/callback"]`, `grant_types: [authorization_code, refresh_token]`, `client_name: "memo-cli"`); loopback server on `127.0.0.1:0`, PKCE S256, `state` check, `resource` param, scope `openid offline_access` plus `scopes_supported` from the PRM if present; open browser (`open` crate) and always print the URL; exchange code; store `{refresh_token, client_id, issuer, token_endpoint, resource}` in keyring service `memo` user `<url origin>` with file fallback 0600. Token getter: `MEMO_TOKEN` wins; cached access token reused until 60 s before `exp` (decode JWT payload without verifying, only for `exp`); refresh grant otherwise; refresh failure → `AuthError::LoginNeeded`. `memo logout` clears keyring, file and cache.

requirements.text: WHEN `memo login` runs THEN it SHALL perform OIDC authorization code + PKCE (S256) with a loopback redirect on `127.0.0.1:<ephemeral port>`, open the browser (print the URL if no browser), and store the refresh token in the OS keyring, falling back to `$XDG_STATE_HOME/memo/credentials` with mode 0600.

WHEN any command needs a token and the cached access token expires within 60 s THEN the CLI SHALL refresh it; IF refresh fails THEN it SHALL report state `login-needed` (no interactive prompt from hooks).
WHEN `MEMO_TOKEN` is set THEN the CLI SHALL use it as the bearer token and skip the keyring.
WHEN `memo logout` runs THEN it SHALL delete stored credentials from keyring and file.

doneWhen.text: Integration vs an in-test fake AS (axum: PRM, discovery, DCR, authorize that redirects straight back with a code, token endpoint verifying PKCE verifier and `resource`): login without browser (test hook env `MEMO_LOGIN_NO_BROWSER=1` + a test client that follows the printed URL) stores credentials; second token call uses cache; expired cache refreshes; failing refresh → LoginNeeded; logout removes all; `MEMO_TOKEN` bypasses everything; wrong `state` rejected
Credentials file mode 0600; tokens never appear in `hook.log` or stdout of `config show`
Full gate (no containers) passes

T4.title: MCP client and manual commands
T4.what: `client.rs`: rmcp streamable-HTTP client to `<url>/mcp` with `Authorization: Bearer` and `X-Cognee-Agent`, `recall(query, top_k, search_type CHUNKS) -> Vec<Hit{layer, text, dataset_name}>`, `remember(text, dataset_name, layer "agent", self_improvement, background true)`, `health()` (`GET <url>/health`). Map 401 → LoginNeeded(reason `audience` if token present), connect/timeout → Offline; update `health.json` on every outcome; record events (`source: hook` by caller choice). Commands `memo recall <q> [--harness h] [--json]`, `memo remember <text>`, `memo note <text>` (NOTE-01; current project dataset, counts write).

requirements.text: Every REST call SHALL send `X-Cognee-Agent: <harness agent>` (D-06) when invoked for a harness, and SHALL never log tokens.
`memo recall <query>` and `memo remember <text>` SHALL work standalone (same layer/dataset rules as hooks) for manual use and testing.
`memo note <text>` SHALL remember into the current project dataset/agent layer, counted as a write.
WHEN memo is unreachable or login is needed THEN the hook SHALL record that state for the indicator and inject nothing.

doneWhen.text: IT (`MEMO_IT=1`): start memo-server on the memo-testkit stack with `MCP_RESOURCE_URL` set (see `crates/memo-server/tests/mcp.rs` for setup), mint a token with the MCP audience, `MEMO_TOKEN=… memo remember "A=1" --harness codex` then `memo recall "value of A" --harness codex --json` returns a hit with layer `agent`; X-Cognee-Agent honoured (a different harness agent does not see it at agent layer)
Unit/integration without containers: unreachable URL → state `offline` within timeout; 401 → `login-needed`
Full gate passes

T5.title: Redaction, turns and capture builder
T5.what: `hook/capture.rs`: `redact(text)` (bearer/JWT `eyJ…\.…\.…`, `sk-[A-Za-z0-9_-]{16,}`, `ghp_`/`gho_`/`github_pat_`, `AKIA[0-9A-Z]{16}`, PEM private key blocks, `(password|passwd|secret|token|api[_-]?key)\s*[=:]\s*\S+` → keep key, value `[REDACTED]`); strip `<memo-recall …>…</memo-recall>` blocks; `append_turn(session, role, text)`; `build_capture(session) -> Option<String>` from `turns[cursor..]` as `user: …` / `assistant: …` lines, newest kept within `max_bytes` (drop oldest whole turns; a single turn larger than cap is cut from its start at a char boundary), `None` when empty; advance cursor on enqueue.

requirements.text: The capture SHALL contain user prompts and final assistant text replies since the last successful capture of that session (cursor kept in local state), in order, labelled `user:` / `assistant:`.
Tool calls, tool results, thinking blocks and system/hook-injected text (including memo's own recall blocks) SHALL be excluded.
Text matching secret patterns (bearer/JWT tokens, `sk-…`/`ghp_…`/AWS keys, PEM private keys, `password=`/`secret=` assignments) SHALL be replaced with `[REDACTED]` before leaving the machine.
The capture SHALL be capped at 32 KiB, keeping the most recent content; empty captures SHALL not be sent.
Capture SHALL be built from hook payloads accumulated per session (prompt text, final assistant text), never from transcript files (DD-12).
WHEN `turn-end` fires THEN memo SHALL append the redacted final assistant text to the session's turns (no network); WHEN `prompt` fires it SHALL append the redacted prompt likewise (DD-12).

doneWhen.text: Unit: table of secret samples all redacted and non-secrets untouched; memo-recall blocks stripped; cap keeps newest; cursor prevents resend; empty → None; multibyte text never split mid-char
Quick gate passes

T6.title: Hook engine
T6.what: `hook/mod.rs` + `hook/recall.rs`: neutral event dispatch with fail-open (any error → log to `S/hook.log`, exit 0, no-op output) and a hard deadline (`recall.timeout_ms` + 500 ms wall). Behaviour per event:

requirements.text: WHEN `session-start` fires THEN memo SHALL recall with query `<project> <branch>` (top_k 8) and inject at most 4 KiB of context formatted as a fenced "memo recall" block listing each hit with its layer.

WHEN `prompt` fires with a prompt ≥ 20 chars that is not a slash command THEN memo SHALL recall with the prompt as query (Chunks, top_k 5) and inject at most 2 KiB; shorter prompts and slash commands SHALL inject nothing and make no call.
WHEN `pre-compact` or `session-end` fires THEN memo SHALL remember the capture (CAPT-*) into the agent layer, dataset = project name (D-07), with `self_improvement` per config.
WHEN `tool-used` fires for a memo MCP tool THEN memo SHALL count `recall` as a read and `remember`/`improve`/`forget` as writes, without calling the server.
Every hook SHALL exit 0 and emit a valid "no-op" native response on any error (fail open); recall SHALL time out after 2 s (configurable); total hook wall time SHALL stay under timeout + 500 ms.
WHEN memo is unreachable or login is needed THEN the hook SHALL record that state for the indicator and inject nothing.

WHEN a remember fails THEN its payload SHALL be appended to the local write queue; every later hook SHALL first try to flush the queue (bounded to 1 s), oldest first; queue bound 100 entries / 5 MiB, dropping oldest and counting drops.
Recall injection SHALL never include hits whose text came from the current session's own capture within the last 60 s (avoid echo) — de-duplicated by text hash.
WHEN `turn-end` fires THEN memo SHALL append the redacted final assistant text to the session's turns (no network); WHEN `prompt` fires it SHALL append the redacted prompt likewise (DD-12).

doneWhen.text: Unit: injection formatting/caps/`(+N more)`; skip rules for short prompt and slash command (no client call — use a client trait + fake); echo filter; tool-name matching table
Integration (fake client): server down → every event exits 0 under 2.5 s, capture lands in queue, `memo flush` later delivers it (fake server) and empties queue; counters and events recorded
Full gate passes

T7.title: Harness adapters (stdin/stdout)
T7.what: `adapters/{claude_code,codex,gemini,opencode}.rs`: `parse(native_event_name, stdin) -> NeutralEvent` and `render(neutral, context) -> stdout`, per design tables. `memo hook <native-or-neutral-event> --harness <h>`: accept the native event name (e.g. `UserPromptSubmit`, `BeforeAgent`, `Stop`) or the neutral name. Outputs: Claude/Codex/Gemini injection = `{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":<native>,"additionalContext":…}}`, no-op = `{}`; Gemini stdout must be JSON only; Codex `Stop` must output JSON; OpenCode = neutral `{"context":…}`. Field mapping: Claude/Codex `prompt`, `last_assistant_message`, `tool_name`; Gemini `prompt`, `prompt_response`, `tool_name`. Each adapter exposes `events() -> &[(Neutral, &'static str native)]` (DD-10).

requirements.text: `memo hook <event> --harness <h>` SHALL read the harness's native hook JSON on stdin, normalise it to a neutral event (`session-start`, `prompt`, `tool-used`, `pre-compact`, `session-end`), and write the harness's native response on stdout.
A capability matrix (harness × neutral event → native event or "unsupported") SHALL live in `integrations/README.md` and be the single source used by the installer.

doneWhen.text: Fixture per harness × supported event (stdin per the field lists in design.md) → expected neutral event; render goldens for inject and no-op
Malformed stdin → exit 0 + no-op output + `hook.log` line
Quick + full (no containers) gates pass

T8.title: `memo mcp` stdio proxy
T8.what: `proxy.rs`: rmcp stdio server exposing exactly the tools memo-server exposes (`remember`, `recall`, `forget`, `improve`, `cognify_status`), schemas fetched from the remote `list_tools` at startup (fallback: static copy if offline, tool calls then return a tool error "memo offline: <reason>"), each call forwarded to `/mcp` with the harness agent header; counts reads/writes into the session file keyed by `--session` if given else `<harness>-mcp-<pid start date>`, events `source: mcp`. Since the harness session id is unknown to the proxy, also append the event with `session: null`; `memo events --session` (T9) attributes `session: null` mcp events to the most recently updated session of that harness.

requirements.text: The MCP client name each harness sends SHALL sanitize to the same agent name the hooks use (D-06); IF a harness's client name differs THEN the installer SHALL configure an `X-Cognee-Agent` header on the MCP entry where the harness supports headers.
Counters SHALL be per Claude Code session id (D-08) and include hook recalls/remembers and memo MCP tool calls.

doneWhen.text: IT: spawn `memo mcp --harness codex` as child, rmcp client over its stdio lists 5 tools, `remember` then `recall` round-trip through the test memo-server; events recorded with `source: mcp`
Offline: tools listed, calls return tool error, process does not exit
Full gate passes

T9.title: statusline, events, status, doctor
T9.what: `memo statusline [--wrap <cmd>] [--color auto|always|never]` (IND-01/02/04/05): stdin Claude status JSON (`session_id`, `cwd`), output per IND-01 using counts from `claude-code-<session_id>` (+ `session: null` mcp events attributed per T8), health probe at most once per 30 s with 300 ms budget (else cached), `⧗<n>` queue; `--wrap` runs `sh -c <cmd>` with the same stdin and prints its stdout then the memo segment on the same last line separated by `│`. `memo events [--json] [--session id] [--harness h] [--limit 20]` → `{ "state", "reason", "url", "agent", "dataset", "reads", "writes", "queued", "drops", "events": [...] }` (PANEL-02 contract). `memo status [--json]` (DIAG-01). `memo doctor` (DIAG-02) with one line per check `ok|warn|fail <check>: <detail>` and a fix hint.

requirements.text: `memo statusline` SHALL read Claude Code's status line JSON on stdin (session id) and print one line: `● memo ↓<reads> ↑<writes>` when connected, `○ memo offline`, `○ memo login` when login is needed, plus `⧗<n>` when the write queue is non-empty.
Connection state SHALL come from the last hook/statusline probe result in local state; `memo statusline` SHALL make at most one `/health` probe per 30 s (cached) and SHALL return within 300 ms.
Counters SHALL be per Claude Code session id (D-08) and include hook recalls/remembers and memo MCP tool calls.

`memo statusline --wrap '<cmd>'` SHALL run an existing status line command (e.g. usage-bar) with the same stdin and print its output followed by the memo segment, so the user's current status line is kept; the installer SHALL configure this wrap when a status line already exists.
Colors SHALL use ANSI only when stdout is a TTY or `--color=always`; `NO_COLOR` disables them.
The panel SHALL read the same local event log as the status line (`memo events --json --session <id>`), never calling memo-server itself.
`memo status [--json]` SHALL show URL, login state (user, expiry), health, agent per harness, queue size/drops, installed harnesses.
`memo doctor` SHALL check binary on PATH, config, login, server health, MCP audience reachability (`/.well-known/oauth-protected-resource/mcp`), and each installed harness's config, printing fixes.

doneWhen.text: Unit/golden: statusline strings for connected/offline/login/queue, NO_COLOR, wrap concatenation; events JSON shape
Timing test: statusline with unreachable server returns < 300 ms
Full gate passes

T10.title: Installer core + Codex
T10.what: `install/mod.rs`: `memo install <harness> [--dry-run] [--remote] [--statusline] [--bin <path>]`, `memo uninstall <harness>`, backups `<file>.memo-bak.<unix_ts>` before first change, unified diff output for `--dry-run` (`similar` crate), idempotency, absolute memo path (`std::env::current_exe` canonicalised, or `--bin`). Codex: `~/.codex/config.toml` (respect `CODEX_HOME`) via `toml_edit`: `[mcp_servers.memo]` stdio (`command`, `args = ["mcp","--harness","codex"]`) or with `--remote` `url = "<url>/mcp"` + `bearer_token_env_var = "MEMO_TOKEN"` + `http_headers = { "X-Cognee-Agent" = "codex" }`; hooks `[[hooks.<Event>]]` with `[[hooks.<Event>.hooks]] type="command" command="<bin> hook <Event> --harness codex" timeout=<s>`; identify memo entries on uninstall by command prefix `<bin> hook` / table name `mcp_servers.memo`. Print the `/hooks` trust reminder. `memo install --matrix` prints the capability matrix markdown from adapters' `events()`.

requirements.text: `memo install <claude-code|opencode|gemini-cli|codex>` SHALL register the memo MCP server (`<MEMO_URL>/mcp`) and the hooks for every neutral event the harness supports, in the harness's user-level config.

Install SHALL be idempotent (second run = no diff), SHALL back up each file it changes to `<file>.memo-bak.<timestamp>` before the first change, and SHALL preserve unrelated user config (comments preserved where the format allows).
`memo uninstall <harness>` SHALL remove exactly the entries memo added, leaving other config untouched.
`memo install --dry-run` SHALL print the diff without writing.
A capability matrix (harness × neutral event → native event or "unsupported") SHALL live in `integrations/README.md` and be the single source used by the installer.

doneWhen.text: Temp `HOME`/`CODEX_HOME`: install into empty and into a pre-existing config with comments and unrelated tables → matches golden; second install = no change; uninstall → byte-identical to original; `--dry-run` writes nothing
